description: Test suite for the '_resolve_callback_url' and '_build_callback_candidates' functions in 'agentfield.agent'. The tests verify URL resolution logic under different environmental conditions, including environment variables, container detection, and local IP detection.

methods.name: test_resolve_callback_url_prefers_explicit_url()
methods.description: Tests that explicit URLs passed to '_resolve_callback_url' are correctly used.

methods.name: test_resolve_callback_url_uses_env(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests URL resolution when 'AGENT_CALLBACK_URL' environment variable is set.

methods.name: test_resolve_callback_url_handles_container_overrides(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests URL resolution when running in a container with service name and environment variables.

methods.name: test_resolve_callback_url_fallback_to_detected_ips(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests URL fallback to container IP or local IP when environment variables are absent.

methods.name: test_resolve_callback_url_final_fallback(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests final fallback URLs when neither environment variables nor container IPs are available.

methods.name: test_build_callback_candidates_includes_defaults(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Tests that default IP-based and hostname-based URLs are included in the candidate list.
